items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: He took my place there. He cut a couple of records with him, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, but we have it on tape.
Yeah. So, at least I hope. He took my place there. He cut a couple of records with him, too. I believe Jumbo's still losing for him.
Did you do any recording with Jumbo?
